title: SB 2633 (2025 Regular Session): Register to vote; require proof of citizenship and 2 proofs of address.
operative_text:

(d_proof_of_citizenship)
(section) Sec. 1 (23-15-11(1)(a))
(quote) is eligible to register to vote, if he or she: (a) Is a citizen of the United States of America, and can provide at least one (1) form of documentation that shall serve as proof of citizenship.
(section) Sec. 1 (23-15-11(1)(a))
(quote) For the purpose of this section, proof of citizenship shall include: (i) The voter's birth certificate or a legible photocopy of the birth certificate; (ii) A United States passport, or a legible photocopy of the pertinent pages of the passport, identifying the voter and showing the passport number;
(section) Sec. 1 (23-15-11(1)(a))
(quote) or (iv) Any document or method of proof of citizenship established by the federal Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986, Public Law 99-603, compiled in 8 U.S.C.
(e_other_rule)
(section) Sec. 1 (23-15-11(1)(c))
(quote) and can provide, at minimum, two (2) forms of proof of address.
(section) Sec. 1 (23-15-11(1)(c))
(quote) For the purpose of this section, proof of address shall include: (i) Valid Mississippi driver's license; (ii) Valid state issued ID; (iii) Current bank statement; (iv) Current cell phone bill; (v) Current utility bill;
(section) Sec. 1 (23-15-11(2))
(quote) shall be a qualified elector in and for the county, municipality and voting precinct of his or her residence, and shall be entitled to vote at any election upon compliance with Section 23-15-563.
(section) Sec. 2 (23-15-13)
(quote) As part of the voter registration transfer application, the voter shall provide proof of address as required by Section 23-15-11(1)(c).
(other) Sec. 2 (23-15-13): moving electors must give proof of address when transferring registration
(other) Sec. 3: effective date
